rationale: The agent verified the user correctly via full name and zip, retrieved the right account and orders, and executed the correct actions (cancelling two pending orders and initiating a return for the correct watch). The refund totals reported match the tool data. However, the agent executed cancellations without first obtaining explicit user confirmation after stating the exact changes to be made, which the policy requires before any order-changing write. Additionally, the agent asserted email instructions would be sent without explicit tool confirmation. Due to the lack of explicit confirmation prior to cancelling the orders, the conversation does not meet the pass bar.
